mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.employee (keycloak_id, email, full_name, status) VALUES (CAST(#{keycloakId} AS uuid), #{email}, #{fullName}, 'ACTIVE') ON CONFLICT (keycloak_id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.keycloak_id, e.email, e.full_name, e.branch_id, b.code AS branch_code, b.name AS branch_name, e.status FROM app.employee e LEFT JOIN app.branch b ON b.id = e.branch_id WHERE e.keycloak_id = CAST(#{keycloakId} AS uuid)
